title: Directional single-scattering with volumetric self-shadowing
motivation: Introduce realistic lighting by integrating light transmittance along light rays.
deliverables: HG phase function with parameter g
Light transmittance estimation via secondary march toward directional light
Parameters: sigma_a, sigma_s, g, lightDir, lightIntensity
acceptance: Soft shadows inside medium; lighting responds to density changes
Parameters visibly affect contrast and anisotropy
No excessive divergence; stable frame time
notes: Keep step counts modest initially; later add occupancy-guided skipping
Consider early-out on high transmittance loss
